storyline.real: Verstappen wins by 19.4 s. Russell runs long on his first mediums and stops once while Hamilton stops twice; with five laps left Mercedes swaps them, Sainz passes Russell too, and Russell finishes seventh, 8.3 s behind Hamilton in fifth.
storyline.headline: Russell turns Suzuka's split strategy into sixth

mastery.label: Finish sixth or better on two stops

hidden.label: Finish sixth or better with a stint on softs

eras.briefing: Suzuka, 2023. Verstappen leads from pole with the two McLarens behind him. You run Russell, eighth after ten laps on mediums, right behind his team-mate Hamilton. Mercedes splits its strategies: get Russell up to sixth or better.
